headline: On 54 real repos, Claude Code with indo finished test tasks about 1.8x faster (95% CI 1.4x to 2.3x) and a full test run 3.3x faster (52.9 s to 15.9 s), with the same correct answers and the same cost.
caveats: One agent and model (Claude Code, Sonnet 5.5) on 54 repos; 3 paired runs per task
Fast commands (git status, fetch) gain little or nothing
One plain-bash Go run stalled for 355 s and is excluded from the headline; results with it are listed
